video.archive: native-feeding-events.js author simulation archive, distinct from paired gain/input study
video.capture: Deterministic source FLY_DEMO.setTime; wait two animation frames; screenshot source scene. CSS presentation-only full-viewport scene and legible view labels. No geometry, spike, policy, movement or contact modifications. Video encoding only, no generated interpolation.
video.limitation: Uncalibrated illustrative body mapping; not animal-motion fit or paired-study finding. Droplet contact and volume illustrative; no fluid physics, swallowing or sensory feedback.

chart.transformation: Redraw all original counts on common 0–90 axes; no new fit or simulation.
chart.limitation: Exploratory model sensitivity; seeds are inputs, not animals. No biological or significance claim.
